## W4-13: search_logs records what happened, and the admin readers skip the probe traffic

Findings: PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-01 / -07 / -10 / -11, PO-CATEGORIES-I18N-13, LS-MEASURED-EVIDENCE-07 / -08. PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-17 (anon_id) stays OPEN as its own row for Ahmed (Q5): a fingerprint-derived id is re-linkable to users.device_fingerprint_hash.

### Defects (measured at ac887e2d = 61585c58 + auth-only #202)
- **The four admin readers aggregate every row.** 88.6 % of the recorded search_logs series is 13 probe strings. On the fixture: daily avg_duration 3,667 ms over 12 rows (organic truth 22,000 over 2); popular[0] = 'product1 vs product2'.
- **Failure rows never carry cost.** Four of five failure sites pass no `cost`. camera.unsuccessful reads metadata.total_cost, which is always absent, because the orchestrator puts total_cost at the TOP level.
- **Delivered partials are unmarked** in the log.
- **The stream logs its success:False TERMINALS as successes** (STREAM_TIMEOUT / INSUFFICIENT_DATA / moderation refusal): success True, cost 0. This is the "0 of 721 stream failures".
- **Abandoned streams and mid-stream raises write nothing.**
- **/url/compare and POST /text/quick write no row at all.**
- **Codeless failures log the service's str(e)** into search_logs.error_message on POST/GET.

### Design
Two per-call flags, both default OFF, read with `.strip().lower() in (true,1,yes,on)`, one definition each in database_service.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_TRUTH (flag 1).** No precondition. Live kill-switch.
- T1: POST/GET failure rows carry `cost` (top-level total_cost, else metadata.total_cost, else 0.0; NaN/inf/negative/bool/str -> 0.0).
- T2: a delivered partial keeps success True and adds error_message 'partial:<stage>'.
- T3: stream success:False terminals log a failure under the NEW label log_search.text_stream.terminal_failure. Billing is UNCHANGED.
- T4: the stream error row carries the event's own (already W4-9-floored) text + cost.
- T5: ONE failure row for an abandoned or raised stream, keyed on client_gone: 'client_gone_before_complete' / 'stream_incomplete'.
- T6: camera unsuccessful cost uses three rungs: top-level total_cost + vision; else metadata.total_cost as-is (the route already added vision); else vision alone (R3).
- T7: the camera exception row carries vision_cost.
- T8: /url/compare writes success / failure / exception rows. The query is scheme + host + explicit port + path; the query string, fragment and userinfo are dropped (R4). user_id is passed. There is no cost (compare_from_urls exposes none).
- T9: POST /text/quick writes rows (Q7/D1).
- R1: under flag 1 every failure row's error_message passes the SAME W4-9 codeless floor the response uses (`_is_codeless_safe_message`, no second allowlist). Coded results log their message unchanged; a codeless non-allowlisted message logs INTERNAL_ERROR_FRIENDLY_MESSAGE. Exception rows log constants ('url_compare_exception', 'quick_compare_exception'), never str(e).
- Every NEW or changed failure row is built AFTER its refund fire_and_forget and before the raise (C3). Builders are total over any input.
- R2: under flag 1 the existing T1/T4/T6/T7 rows therefore move AFTER their refund. Flag 1 also REORDERS the fire_and_forget labels on those paths. There is no response, status or SSE change.
- The url and quick success rows sit after their metering calls.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_MARKER (flag 2) + the SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_TOKEN knob.** HARD PRECONDITION: migration 042 APPLIED.
- log_search gains `is_synthetic=None`. The key is written only when it is not None AND flag 2 is ON.
- Every site passes the caller's classification: header X-Qaren-Synthetic == token, both non-empty (checked before the compare, C2), bytes + surrogateescape compare_digest, no broad except.
- The four readers select `, is_synthetic`, drop `is True` rows (NULL/False kept) and report `synthetic_excluded` on the three dict readers.
- X-Qaren-Synthetic is redacted by the shared Sentry request scrub (both hooks, D4).
- scripts/eval_runner.py sends the header only when the token is set.
- The token is least-privilege: a leak lets the holder mark or hide their OWN traffic only. Rotation = set a new value on Railway web + in the eval runner's env, no code change.

### Flag rows (CLAUDE.md, at merge)
| name | default | effect ON | flag-OFF identity | knobs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_TRUTH | OFF, per call | T1-T9 + R1 as above | C7 ledger base->head->base2 identical record by record | none |
| ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_MARKER | OFF, per call | writer key + readers filter + synthetic_excluded | same ledger; test 8/10/16 pins | SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_TOKEN (secret, per call, never logged) |

### APPLY_PACK row: 042
Apply AFTER merge and BEFORE flag 2. Rollback: flag 2 OFF FIRST, then rollback/042 (it discards the classification).
- The census is an OPERATOR instruction (R5, no DO block): the Supabase SQL editor wraps one pasted multi-statement script in one transaction, so census + body + AFTER check pasted into ONE run is the same-transaction guarantee.
- Paste back three numbers: BEFORE = a + b, EXCLUDED = c, AFTER = BEFORE - EXCLUDED.
- Sanity anchor from the 2026-09-02 pull: a = 11,724, c = 295, AFTER = 11,429 tagged, organic re-stated 1,808 rows / 82.08 % / p50 20,937 ms.
- Live counts will be >= those anchors (rows written since the pull).
- Residual ambiguity: the 295 excluded probe-#1 rows (>= 10 s) may still be probes, and probe-#1 rows under 10 s may be users.

### Activation order
1. Flag 1 alone. Publish the KPI series change the day it flips: under T5/T3, abandoned streams and moderation/timeout terminals count as FAILURES in get_error_stats (the stream failure rate rises from 0), and failure-row cost makes the cost KPI rise. Both are definition changes.
2. Apply 042 (paste-back above).
3. Set SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_TOKEN (web + eval env), then flip flag 2.
4. One-minute canary: the count of rows written after the flip must be > 0 (log_search swallows insert errors, so silence = a missing column). Then check that `is_synthetic IS NULL` rows after the flip = 0.

### Gates (measured; process-wide netguard plugin used, since the hermeticity unit is not merged)
- **Unit files (3):** 170 passed in all 4 states, blocked 0.
- **CI-order set (20 files, one process):** 628 passed x4, 0 failed (red base 468/0 without the new files; prototype 612).
- **Preserve (34 files):** 786 passed / 10 deselected x4 (blocked 29 OFF / 58 flag 1: the same two fail-open targets).
- **Comm (119 files):** HEAD 4F/3045P vs base ac887e2d 4F/2884P; `comm -13` empty. The 4 are the guard-caused SSRF DNS nodes and fail identically at 61585c58. The memo flake passed. The +1 node is the immutability guard now scanning 042.
- **Mutation:** 70 mutants (the red's 48 + R1/R3/R4/R5 + 8 HEAD-row flag-leak analogues), all killed, restores sha-verified. Two pins were rewritten after surviving: the R5 header needle, and a new flag-OFF partial pin for POST/GET/camera.

- **Lint and SQL:** ruff E9,F63,F7,F82 clean; py_compile clean; sqlfluff clean on 042 + rollback.

### Stated limits
- **CD-wave-diffs-02:** under flag 1 the stream LOG says failure while the BILL says delivered for success:False terminals, until W4-13b.
- **NULL window:** rows from 2026-09-03 to the flag-2 flip are never classified, and the readers count them as organic permanently. Measure the window at activation.
- **D2:** the sync CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE exits (prefilter and moderation_api) carry no total_cost, so T1 logs 0.0 for a PAID moderation_api run.
- **URL cost:** url rows carry cost 0.0.
- **Camera exception:** the camera exception row keeps str(e) by spec T7 / M13-26 (R1 did not list T7).
- **Readers have no .range():** they SELECT without pagination, so the PostgREST max-rows cap can truncate every aggregate, and the flag-2 canary on /admin/stats/popular can pass or fail on truncation alone.
- **Pre-existing leak:** the str(e)-in-error_message leak on POST/GET codeless failures stays byte-identical with flag 1 OFF (pinned). R1 closes it only under flag 1.
- **Harness marker:** only eval_runner marks its traffic.

### Follow-ups
- W4-13b: the stream meters success:False terminals.
- W4-13c: synthetic header for bias_matrix_probe.py, bundle_d_prod_smoke.py, run_validation_matrix.py.
- PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-01c: readers without .range() / the PostgREST cap.
- D2: add total_cost to the moderation-refusal / CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE exits.
- Ruling question for Fable: see the R1 note on the url '<2 products' row below.

'Could not extract both products' (url_extraction_service, codeless) is not on the W4-9 allowlist. Under flag 1 the url failure ROW therefore logs INTERNAL_ERROR_FRIENDLY_MESSAGE; the 400 body is unchanged. The red's test 28 expectation was changed accordingly. If Fable wants that constant kept, the ruling needs an explicit exception, because R1 forbids a second allowlist.

**Findings:** PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-01 / -07 / -10 / -11, PO-CATEGORIES-I18N-13, LS-MEASURED-EVIDENCE-07 / -08.

PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-17 (`anon_id`) stays OPEN as its own row for Ahmed (Q5): a fingerprint-derived id can be re-linked to `users.device_fingerprint_hash`.

### Defects (measured at ac887e2d = 61585c58 + the auth-only #202)
- **The four admin readers aggregate every row.** 88.6 % of the recorded `search_logs` series is 13 probe strings. On the test fixture, daily `avg_duration_ms` reads 3,667 over 12 rows; the organic truth is 22,000 over 2. `popular[0]` is 'product1 vs product2'.
- **Failure rows never carry cost.** Four of the five failure sites pass no `cost`. `camera.unsuccessful` reads `metadata.total_cost`, which is always absent there, because the orchestrator puts `total_cost` at the TOP level.
- **Delivered partials are unmarked** in the log.
- **The stream logs its success:False TERMINALS as successes** (STREAM_TIMEOUT / INSUFFICIENT_DATA / moderation refusal) with cost 0. This is the "0 of 721 stream failures".
- **Abandoned streams and mid-stream raises write nothing.**
- **`/url/compare` and POST `/text/quick` write no row at all.**
- **Exception text lands in search_logs.error_message.** Codeless failures on POST/GET log the service's `str(e)`, and the camera exception row logs `str(e)`.

### Design
Two per-call flags, both default OFF. Each is read with `.strip().lower() in (true, 1, yes, on)` and has one definition, in `database_service`.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_TRUTH (flag 1).** No precondition; a live kill-switch.
- **T1:** POST/GET failure rows carry `cost`: top-level `total_cost`, else `metadata.total_cost`, else 0.0. NaN, inf, negative, bool and str all give 0.0.
- **T2:** a delivered partial keeps `success` True and adds `error_message` 'partial:<stage>'.
- **T3:** stream success:False terminals log a failure under the NEW label `log_search.text_stream.terminal_failure`. Billing is UNCHANGED.
- **T4:** the stream error row carries the event's own text (already floored by W4-9) plus its cost.
- **T5:** ONE failure row for an abandoned or raised stream, keyed on `client_gone`: 'client_gone_before_complete' or 'stream_incomplete'.
- **T6:** camera unsuccessful cost has three rungs (R3):
  1. top-level `total_cost` + vision;
  2. else `metadata.total_cost` as-is (the route already added vision);
  3. else vision alone.
- **T7:** the camera exception row carries `vision_cost` and, under flag 1, the constant `camera_exception` (R9(b)). Flag OFF keeps today's `str(e)`.
- **T8:** `/url/compare` writes success / failure / exception rows.
  - The query is scheme + host + explicit port + path. The query string, the fragment and the userinfo are dropped (R4). `user_id` is passed.
  - The `<2 products` failure logs its route-owned literal 'Could not extract both products' VERBATIM (R9(a); a code constant at url_extraction_service.py:596, pinned byte-for-byte against the service source). Any other codeless message takes the floor.
  - No cost: `compare_from_urls` exposes none.
- **T9:** POST `/text/quick` writes rows (Q7/D1).
- **R1 floor.** Under flag 1, every failure row's `error_message` passes the SAME W4-9 codeless floor the response uses (`_is_codeless_safe_message`; no second allowlist).
  - Coded results log their message unchanged.
  - A codeless message that is not on the allowlist logs INTERNAL_ERROR_FRIENDLY_MESSAGE.
  - Exception rows log constants: 'url_compare_exception', 'quick_compare_exception', 'camera_exception'. They never log `str(e)`.
- **C3.** Every NEW or changed failure row is built AFTER its refund `fire_and_forget` and before the raise. Row builders are total over their input.
  - The `/text/quick` and `/url/compare` delivery rows stay total when `metadata` is None or not a dict, and when `products` is not a list. Pinned: flag 1 gives the same 200 body as OFF. Before this fix, a success result with `metadata=None` turned the quick 200 into a 500 under flag 1.

- The url and quick success rows sit after their metering calls (`save_comparison.url` / `record_lifetime.url`, `record_anon.quick`). Pinned.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_MARKER (flag 2) + the SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_TOKEN knob.** HARD PRECONDITION: migration 042 APPLIED.
- `log_search` gains `is_synthetic=None`. The key is written only when it is not None AND flag 2 is ON.
- Every site passes the caller's classification: header `X-Qaren-Synthetic` == the token.
  - Both must be non-empty, checked before the compare (C2).
  - The compare is `compare_digest` over bytes + surrogateescape, with no broad except.
  - With flag 1 OFF, flag 2 alone adds exactly `is_synthetic` to today's rows at every site. Pinned over all 17 sites.
- The four readers select `, is_synthetic`, drop rows where it `is True` (NULL and False are kept) and report `synthetic_excluded` on the three dict readers.
- `X-Qaren-Synthetic` is redacted by the shared Sentry request scrub, in both hooks (D4).
- `scripts/eval_runner.py` sends the header only when the token is set.
- The token is least-privilege: a leak lets the holder mark or hide their OWN traffic only. Rotation = set a new value on Railway `web` and in the eval runner's env; no code change.

Findings: PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-01, -07, -10, -11; PO-CATEGORIES-I18N-13; LS-MEASURED-EVIDENCE-07, -08.
PO-RECORDED-MEASURED-17 (anon_id) stays OPEN as its own row for Ahmed (Q5), because a fingerprint-derived id can be re-linked to users.device_fingerprint_hash.

### Defects (measured at ac887e2d, which is 61585c58 plus the auth-only #202)
- **The four admin readers aggregate every row.** 88.6 % of the recorded search_logs series is 13 probe strings. On the fixture, the daily avg_duration is 3,667 ms over 12 rows, where the organic truth is 22,000 ms over 2 rows. popular[0] is 'product1 vs product2'.
- **Failure rows never carry a cost.** Four of the five failure sites pass no `cost`. camera.unsuccessful reads metadata.total_cost, which is always absent there, because the orchestrator puts total_cost at the TOP level.
- **Delivered partials are not marked** in the log.
- **The stream logs its success:False TERMINALS as successes**, with success True and cost 0. These are STREAM_TIMEOUT, INSUFFICIENT_DATA and the moderation refusal, and they are the "0 of 721 stream failures".
- **Abandoned streams and mid-stream raises write no row.**
- **/url/compare and POST /text/quick write no row at all.**
- **Codeless failures and the camera exception log the service's str(e)** into search_logs.error_message.

### Design
There are two per-call flags. Both default OFF and are read with `.strip().lower() in (true, 1, yes, on)`. Each has ONE definition, in database_service.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_TRUTH (flag 1).** It has no precondition and is a live kill-switch.
- T1: POST/GET failure rows carry `cost`. The value is the top-level total_cost, else metadata.total_cost, else 0.0. NaN, inf, negative, bool, str and an int too large for a float all give 0.0.
- T2: a delivered partial keeps success True and gets error_message 'partial:<stage>'.
- T3: a stream success:False terminal logs a failure under the NEW label log_search.text_stream.terminal_failure. Billing is UNCHANGED.
- T4: the stream error row carries the event's own text (already floored by W4-9) and its cost.
- T5: an abandoned or raised stream writes ONE failure row, keyed on client_gone: 'client_gone_before_complete' or 'stream_incomplete'.
- T6: the camera unsuccessful cost uses three rungs (R3):
  1. top-level total_cost + vision;
  2. else metadata.total_cost as-is (the route already added vision);
  3. else vision alone.
- T7: the camera exception row carries vision_cost. Its message is the constant 'camera_exception', never str(e) (post-green R9(b)). Flag OFF keeps today's str(e).
- T8: /url/compare writes a success, failure or exception row on both verbs.
  - The query keeps scheme + host + an explicit port + path. It drops the query string, the fragment and the userinfo (R4).
  - user_id is the caller's id from get_optional_user, or None for an anonymous caller.
  - There is no cost, because compare_from_urls exposes none.
  - The '<2 products' failure logs its own route literal verbatim (R9(a)). Every other codeless message is floored.
- T9: POST /text/quick writes rows (Q7/D1).
- R1: under flag 1, every failure row's error_message passes the SAME W4-9 codeless floor as the response (`_is_codeless_safe_message`, no second allowlist).
  - A coded result logs its message unchanged.
  - A codeless message that is not allowlisted logs INTERNAL_ERROR_FRIENDLY_MESSAGE.
  - Exception rows log constants: 'url_compare_exception', 'quick_compare_exception' and 'camera_exception'.
- C3: every NEW or changed failure row is built AFTER its refund fire_and_forget and before the raise. The row builders are TOTAL over any input. That includes a products list holding non-dict items, a non-dict metadata, and an int total_cost too large for a float (fix round 2, below).
- R2: under flag 1, the existing T1/T4/T6/T7 rows move AFTER their refund. This also REORDERS the fire_and_forget labels on those paths. There is no response, status or SSE change.
- The url and quick delivery rows sit after their metering calls.

**ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_MARKER (flag 2), with the SEARCH_LOG_SYNTHETIC_TOKEN knob.** HARD PRECONDITION: migration 042 is APPLIED.
- log_search gains `is_synthetic=None`. The key is written only when it is not None AND flag 2 is ON.
- Every site passes the caller's classification, including both /url/compare verbs. A request is synthetic when the X-Qaren-Synthetic header equals the token:
  - both must be non-empty, checked before the compare (C2);
  - the compare is compare_digest over bytes with surrogateescape;
  - there is no broad except.
- The four readers select `, is_synthetic` and drop rows where it `is True`; NULL and False rows are kept. The three dict readers report `synthetic_excluded`.
- The shared Sentry request scrub redacts X-Qaren-Synthetic in both hooks (D4).
- scripts/eval_runner.py sends the header only when the token is set.
- The token is least-privilege: if it leaks, the holder can mark or hide only their OWN traffic. Rotation is to set a new value on Railway `web` and in the eval runner's env. No code changes.

| name | default | effect ON | flag-OFF identity | knobs |

| ENABLE_SEARCH_LOG_TRUTH | OFF, read per call | T1-T9 + R1 + R9 as above; no client-visible byte changes | C7 ledger base -> head -> base2 identical record by record (331d21a9, 42/42) | none |

Apply 042 AFTER merge and BEFORE flag 2. To roll back, turn flag 2 OFF FIRST, then run rollback/042, which discards the classification.
- The census is an OPERATOR instruction (R5, no DO block). The Supabase SQL editor wraps one pasted multi-statement script in one transaction, so pasting the census, the body and the AFTER check into ONE run is the same-transaction guarantee.
